scripts.dev: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo dev
scripts.build: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo build
scripts.generate: cd apps/desktop && CGO_ENABLED=0 go tool mygo generate
scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && go -C apps/desktop test ./...
scripts.lint: oxlint && eslint . --cache && pnpm run lint:go && pnpm run lint:dup
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix && eslint . --cache --fix && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run --fix
scripts.lint:go: go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint fmt --diff && go -C apps/desktop tool golangci-lint run
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --offline && pnpm run ci && pnpm exec nano-staged
